label: Traffic window
lineage: input service_stream_total · 1 series per service · labels: service
publisher: ingress gateway cost rollup · merges every target stream into one service counter before storage
collection: 15s step · samples current at query time
ordering: gateway commit · the merged counter is published on schedule

label: Traffic detail
lineage: input panel_counter_total · 1 series per target · labels: service, target
publisher: application scrape · raw counter exposed by each target
collection: 15s step · samples current at query time
ordering: live collector feed · commits samples in the order they arrive

label: Traffic ledger
lineage: input ledger_stream_total · 1 series per target · labels: service, target
publisher: collection ledger replay · re-commits the same application scrape samples
collection: 15s step · complete for closed observation windows at the ledger flush boundary
ordering: write-ahead ledger · commits drained publications in original scrape-timestamp order

label: Traffic capacity
lineage: input target_stream_total · 1 series per target · labels: service, target
publisher: cross-zone relay mirror · re-publishes each target stream after transit
collection: 15s step · samples trail the live scrape by one collection interval
ordering: relay transit commit · each sample lands one collection interval late

label: Traffic archive
lineage: input archive_stream_total · 1 series per target · labels: service, target
publisher: long-term archive compactor · keeps the last sample of each 30s block
collection: 30s step · samples current at query time
ordering: compactor commit · one retained sample per 30s block
